mapper.select: SELECT piggy_bank_id AS id, wallet_id, name, target_amount, balance, bonus_type, bonus_value, status, is_favorite, first_deposited_at, target_reached_at, achieved_at, canceled_at, created_at, updated_at FROM piggy_banks WHERE piggy_bank_id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE piggy_banks SET bonus_type = #{bonusType}, bonus_value = #{bonusValue}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE piggy_bank_id = #{id}
